lastCompletedStory.title: Wire plan-approval gate production write seam + resolver into the sidecar

openQuestions: US-001's open question (PrdSnapshot has no top-level `title` field, buildPlanApprovalContext falls back to `description` then '(untitled PRD)') is CONFIRMED resolved as designed by this story's own AC5 test: the real production writePlanApprovalGateFn closure (sidecar.ts) reads prd.json via readPrd (status.ts, PrdShape) and passes it straight into buildPlanApprovalContext; the fallback-to-description behavior is exercised end-to-end against a prd.json carrying only `description` (no `title`), and the resulting gate context correctly surfaces that description. No further action needed.
This PRD (CAM-312) has no remaining non-operator stories after US-003 (priority 3 was the last entry in userStories[]); the next supervisor action is the review cycle, not another implement dispatch.
nextStoryContext: US-003 completed the production wiring this epic (CAM-241/153/312) set out to build across US-001/US-002/US-003: (1) makeWritePlanApprovalGateFn (sidecar.ts) is the write-side closure -- reads scripts/cam/prd.json fresh via readPrd on every call, builds the operator-facing summary via buildPlanApprovalContext (US-001), and calls writeGateAndNotify (gate.ts, prior epic) with gate=PLAN_APPROVAL_GATE/options=PLAN_APPROVAL_OPTIONS; it is threaded into runPostPlanActions' runPostAuditAction call as the writePlanApprovalGateFn option, so handleAuditApproved's pause-operator branch (US-002) now writes a real, resolvable gate instead of a dead end. (2) makeProductionGatePhaseFn's registry now carries BOTH IN_PROGRESS_CONFLICT_GATE (US-004, prior epic) and PLAN_APPROVAL_GATE (this story), each dispatched generically by pollAndResolveGate's registry lookup -- never a hard-coded single gate kind. (3) The approve resolver deps (makePlanApprovalResolverDeps) derive the branch name from prd.issueNumber via deriveBranchName (plan-runner.ts) and REPLICATE the checkout-B/write-branchName/add/commit sequence directly (wrapped in one try/catch, best-effort/never-throws) rather than reusing plan-runner.ts's private executeGitProceedBranch, which both throws on a non-zero git exit and calls its own setPhaseFn -- a double-flip conflict with pollAndResolveGate's own setPhaseFn(handler(gate)) call. The reject deps rm prd.json and push a best-effort orchestrator notify (silent no-op when no session pane is live). buildGatePhaseDeps (now exported, ctx.sessionName/realSpawnFn/logEvent all threaded through to makeProductionGatePhaseFn) and makeWritePlanApprovalGateFn (also exported) exist purely for direct behavioral testing against a real tmpdir git repo + gate file -- test/sidecar-gate-phase.test.ts's new AC3/AC4/AC5 describe blocks exercise the FULL real path: writeGateFile -> runDecide(approve|reject) -> buildGatePhaseDeps(...).runGatePhaseFn() -> assert real git branch/commit + gate-file consumption + phase flip, no mocked git calls. This epic (CAM-241/153/312) has no remaining stories in this PRD; the sidecar's next action is the review cycle (cam-review), not a further implement dispatch.
